autodetection_retry.title: Detection retry
autodetection_retry.description: How often to retry the initial connection when the job fails to start, in seconds. Zero disables retries.

dsn.title: DSN
dsn.description: Connection string in [go-mssqldb DSN format](https://github.com/microsoft/go-mssqldb#connection-parameters-and-dsn), such as `sqlserver://user:password@host:1433`. With `cloud_auth.provider` set to `azure_ad`, only the `sqlserver://` URL form is accepted.

cloud_auth.title: Cloud auth
cloud_auth.description: Optional cloud authentication settings for Azure SQL Managed Instance.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Authentication provider for Azure SQL Managed Instance. `none` uses the credentials in `dsn`; `azure_ad` signs in with a Microsoft Entra ID token.

azure_ad.title: Azure AD
azure_ad.description: Microsoft Entra (Azure AD) settings used when provider is `azure_ad`.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: How Netdata obtains the Microsoft Entra ID token. `service_principal` uses an app registration with a client secret, `managed_identity` the identity of the Azure resource running Netdata, and `default` the Azure SDK credential chain.

mode_service_principal.title: Service Principal
mode_service_principal.description: Service principal settings used when mode is `service_principal`.

tenant_id.title: Tenant ID
tenant_id.description: Directory (tenant) ID of the Microsoft Entra tenant that holds the service principal. Required in `service_principal` mode.

client_id.title: Client ID
client_id.description: Application (client) ID of the service principal. Required in `service_principal` mode.

client_secret.title: Client Secret
client_secret.description: Client secret of the service principal. Required in `service_principal` mode.

mode_managed_identity.title: Managed Identity
mode_managed_identity.description: Managed identity settings used when mode is `managed_identity`.

client_id.title: Client ID
client_id.description: Client ID of a user-assigned managed identity. Leave empty to use the system-assigned identity of the Azure resource.

collect_disabled_jobs.title: Collect disabled SQL Agent job executions
collect_disabled_jobs.description: Also create execution charts for disabled SQL Server Agent jobs. The enabled/disabled status chart always covers every job.

functions.title: Functions
functions.description: Configuration for Netdata functions exposed by this collector.

top_queries.title: Top Queries
top_queries.description: Configuration for top-queries. Uses Query Store across enabled user databases and falls back to the plan cache (sys.dm_exec_query_stats) when Query Store is unavailable or disabled.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Query timeout for top-queries requests, in seconds, independent of the metrics `timeout`. Zero uses the built-in 30 seconds.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of query patterns top-queries returns. Zero uses the built-in 500.

time_window_days.title: Time Window (Days)
time_window_days.description: Days of query statistics top-queries covers. Zero uses the built-in 7 days; -1 covers all retained history.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Query timeout for deadlock-info requests, in seconds, independent of the metrics `timeout`. Zero uses the built-in 30 seconds.

use_ring_buffer.title: Use Ring Buffer
use_ring_buffer.description: Read deadlock reports from the ring_buffer target of the built-in `system_health` session instead of its event_file target.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Query timeout for error-info requests, in seconds, independent of the metrics `timeout`. Zero uses the built-in 30 seconds.

session_name.title: Session Name
session_name.description: Name of the server-scoped Extended Events session that captures `error_reported` events.

use_ring_buffer.title: Use Ring Buffer
use_ring_buffer.description: Read error events from the session's ring_buffer target instead of its event_file target.

dsn.ui:help: URL form: `sqlserver://user:password@host:1433`; `sqlserver://host:1433` for Windows Authentication (Windows only); `sqlserver://user:password@host/INSTANCENAME` for a named instance (needs the SQL Server Browser service); `sqlserver://my-instance.dns-zone.database.windows.net:1433?database=master` for an Azure SQL Managed Instance private endpoint. Append `?encrypt=true` for an encrypted connection to a trusted certificate. Percent-encode reserved characters in the password (`@` as `%40`). Azure SQL Database is not supported by this collector.

vnode.ui:help: Charts of this job appear under the Virtual Node instead of this host. Define the Virtual Node in `vnodes.conf` first, then enter its name here.

timeout.ui:help: Accepts decimals for sub-second granularity (e.g., 0.5 for 500ms).

provider.ui:help: `azure_ad` needs a login created `FROM EXTERNAL PROVIDER` for the service principal or managed identity on Azure SQL Managed Instance; the DSN then carries no username and password.

mode.ui:help:
Choose how Netdata gets Azure credentials.

- `service_principal`: Use an Azure app / service principal. Requires `tenant_id`, `client_id`, and `client_secret` in `mode_service_principal`.
- `managed_identity`: Use the managed identity attached to the Azure resource running Netdata. Set `mode_managed_identity.client_id` only for a user-assigned identity.
- `default`: Use the Azure SDK `DefaultAzureCredential` chain. This automatically tries available Azure credential sources, such as environment-based credentials, managed identity, and local developer credentials.

Use `service_principal` for explicit app credentials. Use `managed_identity` when Netdata runs on an Azure resource with an attached identity. Use `default` when you want Azure SDK auto-discovery or local development convenience.

disabled.ui:help: WARNING: query text may contain unmasked PII (customer names, emails, IDs). Query text and runtime views require version-specific server and per-database performance-state permissions.

time_window_days.ui:help: With Query Store the window selects the runtime statistics intervals to aggregate; on the plan-cache fallback it keeps only plans executed within the window. Shorter windows are cheaper on busy servers.

limit.ui:help: The same limit caps the rows error-info returns.

disabled.ui:help: WARNING: Query text may contain unmasked sensitive literals. Requires VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE on SQL Server 2022+, or VIEW SERVER STATE on older versions. Unavailable on Azure SQL Database.

use_ring_buffer.ui:help: The ring buffer is volatile (lost on restart or failover), small, and costlier to parse than the event files. SQL Server and Azure SQL Managed Instance only: Azure SQL Database has no system_health session, so deadlock-info is unavailable there regardless.

disabled.ui:help: WARNING: Error messages and query text may contain unmasked sensitive literals. Requires VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE on SQL Server 2022+, VIEW SERVER STATE on older versions.

session_name.ui:help: Create the session as an administrator, capturing sqlserver.error_reported with the sql_text and query_hash actions, with an event_file target (default) or a ring_buffer target. When it is missing, SQL Server and Managed Instance fall back to system_health with reduced coverage. On Managed Instance, event_file requires an Azure Blob Storage URL and storage access configured for the Database Engine.

use_ring_buffer.ui:help: Use it where event files cannot be stored, such as Managed Instance without configured Blob Storage. The session must be running; events are lost on restart or failover, capacity is limited, and XML parsing costs more CPU than reading event files.

collect_disabled_jobs.ui:help: Adds the same four execution charts (last status, duration, age, current run time) for each disabled job. The stock last-execution alerts still fire only for enabled jobs.
